basis: static read-only review of frozen diagnostic tool and synchronous driver; no per-database operation thread-ID telemetry exists in this Windows artifact
only_explicit_background_thread: Observer.heartbeat; it snapshots counters and writes JSON and does not call SQLite
keeper_creation_use_and_final_close: inside synchronous connect/instrument context on driver caller thread
SQLite_check_same_thread: production online store uses default true; diagnostic does not pass false
limits: This is not a captured Windows trace proving the thread ID of every SQL call; do not label it a dynamic thread audit.
